name: fgetxattr
synopsis: ssize_t fgetxattr(int fd, const char *name, void *value, size_t size);
description: fgetxattr() retrieves the value of an extended attribute associated with an open file descriptor. It places the attribute value into a specified buffer. This function is used for files that are already open via a file descriptor.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file to interrogate

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute to retrieve

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Buffer to store the attribute value

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer in bytes

return_value.success: Returns a nonnegative value which is the size in bytes of the extended attribute value
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The size of the attribute value is larger than the maximum size allowed
The named attribute does not exist, or the process has no access
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem
The size of the value buffer is too small to hold the result
